verdict.rationale: The speech-to-text convert API reference says it supports hosted video or audio files, YouTube URLs, TikTok URLs and other hosting services. That means the service fetches remote media by URL instead of requiring an upload. The evidence is a single short doc snippet, so details of the URL parameter are thin. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that signed or pre-authenticated cloud-storage URLs work, documented parameter details and limits (size, timeout, auth) for URL fetching, independent or hands-on corroboration.
